text:
On reopening of #Haifa office:

Try to come early: the usual west side stairs (corner of Ha-Saraya and Natanzon) to the entrance is still blocked by fences due to the construction, so we needed to do a small walk around to a guard station at the entrance of the garden with the arches. Not sure how long it will be this way. 

Not everyone nearby is aware that the building has reopened yet, so don't let anyone confuse you. The visa office is definitely operational.

Also account for extra time if you have any personal protection items. They will need to check it in and lock it away for you. Before leaving, you retrieve it with a slip they give you. Security seems to have new staff who is training, so entry may be a little slower than usual. 

All in all, the detour and security took an extra +/-15 minutes

We were the first appointment of the first day of reopening, but a lot of walk-ins were already waiting there at 8am. 

I heard a lot of people coming in saying they accidentally went to Kiryat Ata first, because they didn't know Haifa branch reopened. 

They were having a lot of technical difficulties. Our interviews were fairly short, but the whole appointment took over 2 hours due to computer issues.

Otherwise, it's the same old office, a lot of familiar faces, everyone was friendly and in pretty good spirits, and everything went smoothly.
